svg.text: What changes, and what never does
Attended and unattended differ in what you see, never in the result
Attended: a person is there
Unattended: nobody is there
A spinner with the seconds, the megabytes so
far and an emoji for the kind of step, in colour
A line left behind when a long step finishes or
fails
In VS Code or on the web: the same steps
arrive as events and become a progress bar
Before an install that needs sudo: it says
what, and asks
No spinner, no colour, no cursor movement:
plain lines on standard error at most
No question is ever asked: archon answers yes
to its own installs and goes on
A download whose fingerprint is wrong is still
refused: nobody can approve that
Same command, same inputs: same result
and same exit status
